text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain authorization for roadway alterations and modifications and a parking regulation amendment related to work associated with the 2018 reconstruction of Thurodale Avenue. As part of this reconstruction, proposed is the construction of new sidewalks, and curbs/gutters on the north side of Thurodale Avenue from Chiswick Avenue and the west end of Martini Drive and on the south side of Thurodale Avenue east of Chiswick Avenue. The proposed construction of curb/gutter and sidewalk on the section of Thurodale Avenue, between Chiswick Avenue and Renfield Street will see a partial narrowing of the road from 8.4 metres down to 6.7 metres between Chiswick Avenue and a point 30 metres further west. As a result of this narrowing,…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the alterations and modifications to narrow Thurodale Avenue to 6.7 metres from Chiswick Avenue to a point 30 meters west of Chiswick Avenue and the construction of a new 1.8 metre wide sidewalk on the north side of Thurodale Avenue from Renfield Street to Chiswick Avenue, as indicated in Attachment 1, and generally shown on the attached drawing EY18-050 dated May 2018. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Thurodale Avenue, between Chiswick Avenue and a point 36 metres further west.
